```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

# Main Setup
## Directory Creation
```{r}
home_dir <- getwd()

# Creating a list to hold some of the directory paths we re-use throughout
dir_list <- list()
dir_list$home <- home_dir
dir_list$data <- paste(dir_list$home, "data", sep = "/")
dir_list$snRNA_mat <- paste(dir_list$data, "snRNA_mat_files", sep = "/")
dir_list$idat_files <- paste(dir_list$data, "dnam_idat_files", sep = "/")
dir_list$scripts <- paste(dir_list$home, "src/R", sep = "/")
dir_list$plots <- paste(dir_list$home, "plots", sep = "/")
dir_list$docs <- paste(dir_list$home, "docs", sep = "/")
dir_list$rds <- paste(dir_list$home, "rds", sep = "/")
dir_list$h5ad <- paste(dir_list$home, "h5ad", sep = "/")

lapply(dir_list, dir.create, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

saveRDS(dir_list, file = paste(dir_list$rds, "dir_list.rds", sep = "/"), compress = FALSE)
gc()
```

## Additional setup
```{r}
# Run only once - time-consuming step
if (!file.exists(".setup_done")) {
  source(paste(dir_list$scripts, "01_setup.R", sep = "/"))
  file.create(".setup_done")
}
```

## Loading Libraries
```{r}
suppressMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(Seurat)
  library(slingshot)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr")
  conflicted::conflicts_prefer(Seurat::Assays)
  })
```

## Setting Seed
```{r}
seed.use <- 12345
set.seed(seed = seed.use)
```

# Scripts
```{r}
## Run following chunk to re-run all scripts used for data analysis. This generates all the results and the data required for the plots.
quiet_source <- function(file) {
  suppressWarnings(
    source(file)
  )
}

script_list <- c("helper_functions.R", sort(list.files(dir_list$scripts, pattern = "^[0-9]+_.*\\.R$")))

lapply(script_list, quiet_source)
```


# Figures
## Fig 2
### 2a (Left)
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(dir_list$plots, "2a_Bulk_RNA_PCA_plot", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 8 
plot_width <- 12 

rna_pca <- assay(rna_counts_rlog) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(row_var = matrixStats::rowVars(as.matrix(.))) %>%  
  slice_max(row_var, n = 500) %>% 
  select(-row_var) %>% 
  t() %>% 
  prcomp(., center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

percentVar <- round(100 * (rna_pca$sdev^2 / sum(rna_pca$sdev^2))[1:2])

rna_pca <- as.data.frame(rna_pca$x) %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = rownames(.)) %>% 
  inner_join(metadata, by = "sample_id")

rna_pca %>% 
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2, color = cell_line, label = sample_id)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = sample_id), size = 10/2.845, box.padding = 0.5, max.overlaps = 100) + 
  labs(x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance"),
       color = "Cell Line") +
  theme_light() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11))

ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), device = "svg", width = plot_width, height = plot_height)
ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", width = plot_width, height = plot_height, dpi = 320, limitsize = FALSE, bg = "white")
```

### 2b (Left)
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(dir_list$plots, "2b_Bulk_RNAseq_DPSC_iN_Mean_plot", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 7
plot_width <- 7

plot_data <- rna_exp_norm %>% 
  mutate(log2_mean_iN = rowMeans(across(matches("DPSC-iN[0-4]"), ~log2(. + 1))), 
         log2_mean_Native = rowMeans(across(matches("DPSC[0-4]"), ~log2(. + 1)))) %>%
  inner_join(rna_DPSC_vs_iN %>% select(gene_name_unique, status), by = "gene_name_unique") %>% 
  select(gene_name_unique, status, log2_mean_iN, log2_mean_Native)

colours <- c("Upregulated" = "firebrick3", "Downregulated" = "steelblue", "Insignificant" = "black")

labels <- sapply(names(colours), function(level) {
  num_genes <- rna_DPSC_vs_iN %>% filter(status == level) %>% nrow()
  label <- paste(level, "(", num_genes, ")", sep = "")
})
colour_scale <- scale_colour_manual(name = NULL, labels = labels, values = colours)

plot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=log2_mean_Native, y=log2_mean_iN, colour=status)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = plot_data %>% filter(status != "Insignificant"), size = 0.8) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  colour_scale +
  labs(x = "log2(mean DPSC)",
       y = "log2(mean NCAM1+ iN)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11))

ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), height = plot_height, width = plot_width)
ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", height = plot_height, width = plot_width, limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 320, bg = "white")
```

### 2c
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(dir_list$plots, "2c_Bulk_RNAseq_DPSC_iN_GO_ORA_plot", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 6
plot_width <- 10

p1 <- rna_DPSC_vs_iN_ora_up@result %>%
  slice_min(p.adjust, n = 10) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(gene_ratio = sapply(strsplit(as.character(GeneRatio), "/"),
                     function(x) as.numeric(x[1])/as.numeric(x[2])),
         Description = str_wrap(Description, width = 30)) %>% 
  select(Description, gene_ratio, Count, p.adjust) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gene_ratio, y = reorder(Description, gene_ratio))) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = p.adjust, size = Count), shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_gradient(high = "gray94", low = "firebrick1", limits = c(0, 0.01), labels = scales::label_scientific(digits = 2)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.05, 0.1), limits = c(0, 0.1)) +
  scale_size(range = c(0, 10), limits = c(25, 250)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Gene Ratio",
       size = "Gene Count",
       fill = "Adj. p value")

p2 <- rna_DPSC_vs_iN_ora_down@result %>%
  slice_min(p.adjust, n = 10) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(gene_ratio = sapply(strsplit(as.character(GeneRatio), "/"),
                     function(x) as.numeric(x[1])/as.numeric(x[2])),
         Description = str_wrap(Description, width = 30)) %>% 
  select(Description, gene_ratio, Count, p.adjust) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gene_ratio, y = reorder(Description, gene_ratio))) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = p.adjust, size = Count), shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_gradient(high = "gray94", low = "firebrick1", limits = c(0, 0.01), labels = scales::label_scientific(digits = 2)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.05, 0.1), limits = c(0, 0.1)) +
  scale_size(range = c(0, 10), limits = c(25, 250)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Gene Ratio",
       size = "Gene Count",
       fill = "Adj. p value")

p1 + p2 + plot_layout(guides = "collect")

ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), height = plot_height, width = plot_width)
ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", height = plot_height, width = plot_width, limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 320, bg = "white")
```

### 2e
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(dir_list$plots, "2e_MS_Prot_OXYPHOS_BoxPlot", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 4
plot_width <- 5

genes <- c("MT-ATP6", "SLC25A12", "NDUFC2", "ATP5MC3", "COX20")

plot_data <- ms_prot_data_filt_log2 %>%
  filter(gene_name %in% genes) %>% 
  pivot_longer(names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "norm_counts", cols = metadata$sample_id) %>% 
  inner_join(metadata %>% select(sample_id, cell_line, donor_id), by = join_by("sample_id"))

for (gene_sym in unique(plot_data$gene_name)) {
  sub_plot_name <- paste(plot_name, gene_sym, sep = "_")
  
  plot_data %>% 
    filter(gene_name == gene_sym) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = cell_line, y = norm_counts)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(colour = cell_line)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(group = donor_id), color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.7) +
  labs(title = gene_sym,
       x = "Cell Line",
       y = "Normalized Abundance") +
  theme_classic() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme(legend.position="none",
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11)) 

  ggsave(filename = paste(sub_plot_name,
                        "svg",
                        sep = "."),
       height = plot_height,
       width = plot_width,
       limitsize = F)

ggsave(filename = paste(sub_plot_name,
                        "png",
                        sep = "."),
       device = "png",
       dpi = 320,
       height = plot_height,
       width = plot_width,
       limitsize = FALSE)
}
```

### 2g and 2h - Required
```{r}
gene_markers_list <- list()
gene_markers_list[["DPSC/MSC"]] <- c("NES", "NT5E", "ENG", "CD44", "THY1", "MCAM", "SEPTIN7")

gene_markers_list[["Mitotic"]] <- c("MCM2", "MKI67", "TOP2A", "FOXM1", "BUB1", "PLK1", "E2F1", "STK6", "PCNA", "MCM1", "MCM3", "MCM4", "MCM5", "MCM6", "MCM7", "MCM8", "MCM9", "MCM10", "CDC2", "CCNA2", "CCNE1", "CCND1", "CCNB1", "MYBL2", "CDK1", "CDK2", "BIRC5", "AURKA", "AURKB")

gene_markers_list[["Mature Neuronal"]] <- c("CDKN1A", "CDKN1B", "CDKN2A", "RB1", "MAP2", "MAPT", "TUBB3", "NCAM1", "NEFM", "NEFL", "ELAVL3", "ASCL1", "INA", "NEUROD1", "NFIA", "NFIB", "SNAP25", "SYN1", "SYP", "SOX4")

gene_markers_list[["Epigenetic"]] <- c("PRC1", "PRC2", "DNMT1", "DNMT3A", "TET2", "TET3", "EZH2", "DOT1L", "KDM6A", "KDM6B", "KDM1A", "KDM5")

gene_markers_list[["Metabolic"]] <- c("PPARGC1A", "ESRRG", "SLC25A20", "ENO2", "SLC2A1", "SLC2A3", "HK1", "PFKM", "ALDOA", "ENO1", "LDHA", "LDHB", "PGK1", "PGM1", "HK2", "G6PD", "TKT", "TALDO1")

gene_markers <- purrr::imap_dfr(gene_markers_list, ~ data.frame("Category" = .y, "Genes" = .x, stringsAsFactors = TRUE))
```

### 2g
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(dir_list$plots, "2g_Bulk_RNAseq_Major_Markers_Heatmap", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 14
plot_width <- 5
cell_dim <- 12

annotation_col <- metadata %>% 
  select(sample_id, cell_line, age) %>% 
  arrange(cell_line, sample_id) %>% 
  rename("Cell Line" = "cell_line",
         "Age" = "age") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("sample_id")

annotation_row <- gene_markers %>% 
  arrange(Category) %>% 
  filter(Genes %in% rna_DPSC_vs_iN_filt$gene_name) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("Genes")

gaps_row <- cumsum(table(annotation_row$Category))

exp_mat <- rna_exp_norm %>% 
  filter(gene_name %in% rownames(annotation_row)) %>% 
  mutate(gene_name = factor(gene_name, levels = rownames(annotation_row))) %>%
  arrange(gene_name) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "gene_name_unique") %>% 
  select(rownames(annotation_col))

scale_colours <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))
  scale_colours <- colorRampPalette(scale_colours)(100)
  
pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = exp_mat, annotation_col = annotation_col, annotation_row = annotation_row, scale = "row", color = scale_colours, cluster_cols = FALSE, cluster_rows = FALSE, angle_col = 45, gaps_row = gaps_row, gaps_col = c(4), filename = paste0(plot_name, ".png"), cellwidth = cell_dim, cellheight = cell_dim, height = plot_height, width = plot_width)

pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = exp_mat, annotation_col = annotation_col, annotation_row = annotation_row, scale = "row", color = scale_colours, cluster_cols = FALSE, cluster_rows = FALSE, angle_col = 45, gaps_row = gaps_row, gaps_col = c(4), filename = paste0(plot_name, ".pdf"), cellwidth = cell_dim, cellheight = cell_dim, height = plot_height, width = plot_width)
```

```{r}
plot_name <- paste(dir_list$plots, "Supp_3b_DNAm_PCA_plot", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 8 
plot_width <- 12

dnam_pca <-  dnam_dmr_ann %>% 
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") %>% 
  select(matches("^DPSC(-iN)?[0-4]")) %>% 
  mutate(row_var = matrixStats::rowVars(as.matrix(.))) %>%  
  slice_max(row_var, n = 500) %>% 
  select(-row_var) %>% 
  t() %>% 
  prcomp(., center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

percentVar <- round(100 * (dnam_pca$sdev^2 / sum(dnam_pca$sdev^2))[1:2])

dnam_pca <- as.data.frame(dnam_pca$x) %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = rownames(.)) %>% 
  inner_join(metadata, by = "sample_id")

dnam_pca %>% 
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2, color = cell_line, label = sample_id)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = sample_id), size = 10/2.845, box.padding = 0.5, max.overlaps = 100) + 
  labs(x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance"),
       color = "Cell Line") +
  theme_light() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11))

ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), device = "svg", width = plot_width, height = plot_height)
ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", width = plot_width, height = plot_height, dpi = 320, limitsize = FALSE, bg = "white")
```

### 3c
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(dir_list$plots, "Supp_3c_DNAm_DPSC_iN_Volcano_plot", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 7 
plot_width <- 10

volcano_data <- dnam_dmr_ann %>% 
  mutate(log10P = -log10(adj.P.Val))

colours <- c("Hypermethylated" = "#D62728", "Hypomethylated" = "#1F77B4", "Insignificant" = "gray70")

labels <- sapply(names(colours), function(level) {
  num_genes <- dnam_dmr_ann %>% filter(status == level) %>% nrow()
  label <- paste(level, "(", num_genes, ")", sep = "")
})

colour_scale <- scale_colour_manual(name = NULL, labels = labels, values = colours)
  
ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = logFC, y = log10P)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = status), size = 2) +
  geom_point(data = subset(volcano_data, status != "Insignificant"),
             aes(color = status), size = 2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  colour_scale +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11)) +
  labs(colour = "Change in Abdundance",
        x = "logFC iN/DPSC",
        y = "-log10(Adj. p-value)")

ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), device = "svg", width = plot_width, height = plot_height)
ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", width = plot_width, height = plot_height, dpi = 320, limitsize = FALSE, bg = "white")
```

### 4f
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(dir_list$plots, "4f_snRNA_UMAP_Lin_Traj", sep = "/")
plot_width <- 7
plot_height <- 5

mm           <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + factor(snRNA_so_final$cluster_ann))
colnames(mm) <- levels(snRNA_so_final)
umap_emb     <- snRNA_so_final@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings
lc           <- sapply(lineages@lineages, function(x) rev(x)[1])
centroids    <- as.data.frame(t(t(umap_emb) %*% mm) / Matrix::colSums(mm))

lc_centroids <- centroids %>%
  slice(match(lc, levels(snRNA_so_final))) %>%
  mutate(label = gsub("Lineage", "L", names(lc)))

umap_emb %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(cluster = snRNA_so_final$cluster_ann) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = cluster), size = 0.5, alpha = 1) +
  geom_path(
    data = slingCurves(lineage_traj_curves) %>%
      lapply(function(c) as.data.frame(c$s[c$ord, ])) %>%
      bind_rows(.id = "lineage"),
    aes(group = lineage), linewidth = 0.8, colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(data = lc_centroids, size = 8, colour = "black") +
  geom_text(data = lc_centroids, aes(label = label), colour = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 3) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
  NoLegend()

ggsave(paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), device = "svg", bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE, width = plot_width, height = plot_height)
ggsave(paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE, width = plot_width, height = plot_height, dpi = 320)

rm(mm, lc_centroids, umap_emb, centroids)
gc()
```

### 4d
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(dir_list$plots, "Supp_4d_snRNA_Nuclei_Recovered_PostQC", sep = "/")
plot_width <- 7
plot_height <- 5

cell_count_table <- snRNA_so_qc@meta.data %>% 
  select(sample_id) %>% 
  summarise("Nuclei Recovered" = n(), .by = c("sample_id"))

cell_count_table <- snRNA_so_final@meta.data %>% 
  select(sample_id) %>% 
  summarise("Nuclei After Quality Control" = n(), .by = c("sample_id")) %>% 
  inner_join(cell_count_table, by = "sample_id")

cell_count_table %>% 
  mutate(`Nuclei Recovered` = (`Nuclei Recovered` - `Nuclei After Quality Control`)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Nuclei"), names_to = "Stage", values_to = "Nuclei Count") %>% 
  mutate(Stage = factor(Stage, levels = c("Nuclei Recovered", "Nuclei After Quality Control"))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=sample_id, fill=Stage, y=`Nuclei Count`)) +
  	geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") +
  	theme_classic() +
    labs(y = "Nuclei Count", fill = "Stage") +
  	theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1, size = 12),
  	      axis.title.x = element_blank())

ggsave(paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), device = "svg", bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE, width = plot_width, height = plot_height)
ggsave(paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE, width = plot_width, height = plot_height, dpi = 320)
```

### 4e
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(dir_list$plots, "Supp_4e_snRNA_Prop_Nuclei_Per_Cluster_Per_Sample", sep = "/")
plot_width <- 7
plot_height <- 4

snRNA_so_final@meta.data %>% 
  group_by(cluster_ann, sample_id) %>%
  summarise(cell_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(cluster_ann) %>% 
  mutate(perct = (cell_count/sum(cell_count)) * 100) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = cluster_ann, y = sample_id, fill = perct)) +
    geom_tile(color = 'white') +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(perct, digits = 2)), size = 2.5) +
    scale_x_discrete(name = "Cluster", position = 'bottom') +
    scale_y_discrete(name = "Sample") +
    scale_fill_gradient(name = "% Cells", low = 'white', high = '#c0392b', na.value = '#bdc3c7', guide = guide_colorbar(frame.colour = 'black', ticks.colour = 'black', title.position = 'left', title.theme = element_text(hjust = 1, angle = 90), barwidth = 0.75, barheight = 10)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = 'right', panel.grid.major = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  coord_fixed()

ggsave(paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), device = "svg", bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE, width = plot_width, height = plot_height)
ggsave(paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE, width = plot_width, height = plot_height, dpi = 320)
```

### 4g
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(dir_list$plots, "Supp_4g_snRNA_Lin2_StartvsEnd_Top_Genes_Heatmap", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 6
plot_width <- 11
cell_width  <- 0.03
cell_height <- 15

genes <- c(traj_gene_list$StartEnd_lin2_filt %>% 
  slice_max(logFClineage2, n = 10) %>%
  rownames(.),
  traj_gene_list$StartEnd_lin2_filt %>% 
  slice_min(logFClineage2, n = 10) %>% 
  rownames(.))

so <- snRNA_so_final %>% subset(cluster_ann %in% c("Fibroblast-Like_1", "Fibroblast-Like_2", "Fibroblast-Like_3", "Intermediary_1", "Unknown_Fate"))

annotation_col <- so@meta.data %>% 
  select("Cluster" = cluster_ann, "Pseudotime" = pseudotime_Lineage2) %>% 
  arrange(Pseudotime)

exp_mat <- GetAssayData(so, assay = "RNA", layer = "scale.data") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  filter(rownames(.) %in% genes) %>% 
  arrange(match(rownames(.), genes)) %>% 
  select(rownames(annotation_col))

scale_colours <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))
  scale_colours <- colorRampPalette(scale_colours)(100)
  
pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = exp_mat, annotation_col = annotation_col, scale = "row", color = scale_colours, cluster_cols = FALSE, cluster_rows = FALSE, show_colnames = FALSE, cellwidth = cell_width, cellheight = cell_height, filename = paste0(plot_name, ".png"), height = plot_height, width = plot_width, res = 320)

pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = exp_mat, annotation_col = annotation_col, scale = "row", color = scale_colours, cluster_cols = FALSE, cluster_rows = FALSE, show_colnames = FALSE, cellwidth = cell_width, cellheight = cell_height, filename = paste0(plot_name, ".pdf"), height = plot_height, width = plot_width)
```
